newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HSBC's BBME to buy two Habib Zurich Oman branches.
newsitem.headline: HSBC's BBME to buy two Habib Zurich Oman branches.

text.p: HSBC Holdings Plc said on Monday its British Bank of the Middle East would buy two branches of Habib Bank AG Zurich in Seeb and Salalah, Oman.
The British Bank of Middle East would acquire approximately OMR1.4 million in assests and OMR600,000 in deposits with the purchase of the two branches, HSBC said in a statement.
The agreement was expected to be concluded on December 31, while the acquisition had received approval in principle from the Central Bank of Oman, it said.
Following the purchase, the BBME would have 28 branches throughout the region, HSBC said.
